title: 3 Caraga LGUs scrap Christmas parties due to El Niño

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— Three local government units (LGUs) in the Caraga Region have canceled their 2026 year-end Christmas parties for government workers, saying funds for lavish parties are better realigned to mitigate the super El Niño impacts next year and in solidarity with residents facing economic hardships. These LGUs are Loreto in Agusan del Sur, and the cities of Tandag in Surigao del Sur and Cabadbaran in Agusan del Norte. In Loreto, Mayor Alvin Otaza said the canceled holiday party is part of the local government’s early preparations for the anticipated effects of the “Super El Niño” next year. READ: […]...
